portal_set_truth.definition: One current-view pedestrian glass-door bank or glass entrance boundary. Adjacent leaves and fixed glass panels form one functional portal set rather than separate target identities.
portal_set_truth.membership_rule: Candidate center is inside the frozen portal-set region and at least half of candidate area lies inside it.

1.kind: HKPC main glass exit door bank

2.kind: Chong Yuet Ming central double exit door

3.kind: MTR Headquarters foreground glass entrance plane

4.kind: Chater House multi-leaf glass entrance bank

5.kind: Chu Kong Shipping Tower lower glass entrance bank

frame_audit.1: Current-view glass exit bank with repeated vertical handles and frames.
frame_audit.2: Central double exit door inside a larger repeated glass facade.
frame_audit.3: Foreground glass entrance plane and opening boundary; distant inner doorway is not the target box.
frame_audit.4: Wide multi-leaf glass entrance bank with repeated posts and handles.
frame_audit.5: Lower cropped multi-leaf glass entrance bank; upper facade glazing is context only.
frame_audit.6: Centered double glass entrance with repeated posts and handles.

fresh_gate: Unchanged v2 lattice top-3 portal-set membership must be at least 4/6 and strictly exceed zero recall. Run once without tuning.
claim_boundary: This authority covers current-image functional glass-door-bank membership only; not requested-entity identity, public access, traversability, temporal tracking, guidance, arrival, benefit, or safety.
